patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: They started on my tummy and now they're EVERYWHERE, even in my hair. Mum keeps telling me not to scratch. That is an unreasonable request.
presentation.triageNote: 10-year-old unvaccinated male with two days of an itchy vesicular rash appearing in crops at different stages, with a mild fever; he is eating, drinking and systemically well.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this systemically well child has uncomplicated varicella requiring isolation precautions but no counted treatment resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This unvaccinated child has crops of itchy vesicles at different stages with only mild fever and preserved intake.
clinical.acuityReason: This systemically well child has uncomplicated varicella requiring isolation precautions but no counted treatment resource.
keyFindings: Two days of itchy vesicular rash
Lesions in crops at different stages
teachingPoints: Uncomplicated chickenpox in a well child needs no resources at all — but it is airborne AND contact spread, so mask them at the door and keep them away from pregnant or immunosuppressed people. Never give aspirin (Reye's).
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Airborne and contact precautions, symptom care, exposure counseling, and return guidance would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting cross-legged on the chair, one hand caught mid-scratch at his arm

signs: crops of small red spots and fluid-filled blisters at different stages scattered over face, arms and trunk
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 10-year-old boy in shorts and a t-shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting cross-legged on the chair, one hand caught mid-scratch at his arm. Expression: itchy and grumpy but bright and alert. Clearly visible: crops of small red spots and fluid-filled blisters at different stages scattered over face, arms and trunk; a hand caught mid-scratch. Overall: systemically well, thoroughly itchy. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
